Wrestler Antim Panghal Focuses on Medals, Postpones Sweet Treats

Wrestler Antim Panghal has stated her commitment to achieving medals at the Asian Games and the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. She has declared a personal ban on consuming jalebis until after the 2028 Olympic Games. This decision reflects her dedication to her athletic goals.
